title: Territory API
description: API for creating and managing in-world regions with efficient tracking, persistent storage, and simple enter/exit/tick events for gameplay mechanics like zones, arenas, and protected areas
body:
Territory API is a framework for defining and managing in-world regions of arbitrary shapes, providing a unified event-driven system for detecting entity interactions such as entering, exiting, and staying within zones. It offers persistent region storage tied to the world lifecycle, flexible metadata support for attaching custom data to regions, and a consistent priority system for resolving overlapping areas. The API is designed to eliminate repetitive per-tick distance checks by providing optimized spatial tracking and a clean abstraction layer for gameplay systems like arenas, protected territories, RPG zones, and environment-based mechanics.

API Documentation >> [*click*](https://github.com/MEGO874/territory-api-doc)
